chapter: Ann Cook session and Buddy Petit stories
title: Playing summers at the Mandeville hotel with Lee Collins
summary: Humphrey and Lee Collins held a Saturday-night summer contract at a Mandeville hotel; the men discuss the bass player and the Fritz brothers.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I think it, man, you know what me and Lee Collins did? We went over there to Mandeville. We played over there at the hotel. Me and Lee had the very name. We played for the hotel over there. Every Saturday night, you know, during the summer session. Contract. When our buddies over there played with a fella named... He played bass violin. He had him and the Fritz brothers. E Flatt was his name?

The other, they called him E Flatt. Well, now, the Fritz brothers... Good kind of guy, we guessed him over there. Yeah. Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson? Lake Branche? Yeah, over around Covington he played in Mandeville.
Yeah. Good kind of guy, and his brother played guitar.
His daddy played too, didn't he? Yeah, man. He's flat ahead. Three or four bass problems.
He played bass problems. Good bass problems.
